about_the_role: We build the internal API platform that every other team at CoreLayer depends on. You will work on services that must stay up while being changed weekly.
responsibilities: Build and maintain Python microservices exposing REST and GraphQL endpoints.
Own database schema changes from design through migration and rollout.
Improve API latency by profiling queries and adding caching where it is justified.
Write clear API documentation and keep OpenAPI schemas accurate.
Participate in an on-call rotation with a supportive escalation path.
required_skills: Professional or project experience with Python for backend development.
Practical understanding of REST APIs, HTTP semantics and status codes.
SQL proficiency and comfort with schema design in PostgreSQL.
Experience with a Python web framework such as FastAPI, Django or Flask.
Version control with Git and a habit of small, reviewable commits.
Ability to write unit tests and reason about edge cases.
preferred_skills: Experience with Docker for local development and deployment.
Familiarity with authentication patterns including JWT and session handling.
Exposure to Redis, Celery or other asynchronous task processing.
Knowledge of Linux server administration and Nginx.
Experience with monitoring tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.
Understanding of web security basics and the OWASP Top Ten.
qualifications: Degree in Computer Science or demonstrable equivalent self-taught experience.
A public repository or project showing backend code you have written.
